answer: Because the rationale is hashed into the crystal record and indexed in the karst history, the plume audit keeps the original text and a copied rationale is provable. Filling 41 aliases therefore needs 41 separate readings of the chain, which is research work rather than text generation. Every submission carries a rationale field that must mention at least 6 distinct ledger facts, and a rationale that merely restates the answer is rejected as a duplicate of its own body.
